training_sample: one full two-object RGB with two instance masks and both token bundles
prompt_template: a photo of {left_bundle} on the left and {right_bundle} on the right
reconstruction: mean of independently mask-normalized left and right diffusion losses
caa: ColorPeel pairwise cosine attention alignment within each three-token object bundle, averaged over objects

instance_attention.source: ICE Stage Two mask-to-attention Wasserstein guidance
